privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This privacy policy describes how Omniaweb S.r.l.s processes the personal data of users of the omniamarketing.it website, in accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (“GDPR”) and Legislative Decree 196/2003, as amended by Legislative Decree 101/2018 (“Privacy Code”).

sections.heading: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: The Data Controller is Omniaweb S.r.l.s, VAT No. 09553001216, with registered office at Vico Bagnara, 4 — 80135 Naples. For any inquiries regarding the processing of personal data, please write to info@omniamarketing.it. Given the size of the organization, there is no mandatory requirement to appoint a Data Protection Officer (DPO) pursuant to Article 37 of the GDPR; the related functions are carried out directly by the Data Controller.

sections.heading: 2. What Data Do We Collect?
sections.body:
Depending on how you interact with the site, we may collect:

  • Contact information — name, email address, phone number (optional), and the content of your message, when you fill out the contact form or the information request pop-up.
  • Newsletter subscription data — email address, when you voluntarily subscribe to receive updates from our blog.
  • Tax information — address, ZIP code, city, and tax ID number, only if necessary to issue accounting documents for an ongoing contractual relationship.
  • Anonymous personalization data — a randomly generated identifier, the name you optionally provide, and the categories of content you visit, stored only on your device and never transmitted to our servers. Full details are available in the Cookie Policy.
  • Technical browsing data — IP address, browser and device type, and pages visited, collected automatically by the hosting infrastructure for security purposes and to ensure the proper functioning of the service, and stored in system logs for a limited period.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and Legal Bases for Data Processing
sections.body:
PurposeLegal Basis
To respond to contact requests or requests for quotesPre-contractual measures at your request (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
To provide a service that has already been requestedPerformance of the contract (Art. 6.1.b GDPR)
Accounting and tax complianceLegal obligation (Art. 6.1.c GDPR)
Sending the newsletterConsent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR), which may be revoked at any time
Anonymous content personalizationConsent (Art. 6.1.a GDPR), revocable at any time
Technical security, prevention of misuse, system logsLegitimate interest of the Data Controller (Art. 6.1.f GDPR)

sections.heading: 4. Recipients and External Data Processors
sections.body:
Your data may be processed, on our behalf and in their capacity as data processors pursuant to Article 28 of the GDPR, by the following service providers:

  • Supabase Inc. — database hosting and file storage (portfolio images/videos). It provides a GDPR-compliant Data Processing Addendum.
  • Resend — sending transactional emails and newsletters. It is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, the transfer mechanism deemed adequate by the European Commission in its decision of July 10, 2023.
  • Application hosting provider — technical operation of the website and related security logs.

We do not sell or transfer your personal data to third parties for marketing purposes by entities other than ourselves.

sections.heading: 5. Data Transfers Outside the EU
sections.body: Some of the suppliers listed in section 4 have their headquarters or infrastructure in the United States. In these cases, data transfers are carried out on the basis of appropriate safeguards pursuant to Chapter V of the GDPR: the provider’s participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, or, failing that, the adoption of the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission via Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/914.

sections.heading: 6. Retention Period
sections.body:
• Contact requests: up to 24 months from the last contact, unless otherwise required by law.
  • Newsletter subscription: until you unsubscribe, which you can do with a single click in every email.
  • Accounting and tax data: 10 years, as required by civil and tax laws.
  • Anonymous personalization data: remains only on your device, never on our servers; you can delete it yourself at any time (see point 9).
  • Technical system logs: generally no longer than 6 months, unless there are proven security needs or the need to investigate criminal offenses.

sections.heading: 7. Data Security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect data from unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure: encrypted HTTPS connections, professional hosting infrastructure, and access to the administrative area that is protected by authentication and restricted to authorized personnel.

sections.heading: 8. Minors
sections.body: This website is not intended for children under the age of 16, and we do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us to have it removed.

sections.heading: 9. Manage Your Preferences
sections.body: For anonymous content personalization (based on consent), you can enable or disable it at any time directly from here:

sections.heading: 10. Your Rights
sections.body:
At any time, and without having to provide a reason, you have the right to:

  • access your personal data (Art. 15 GDPR);
  • request that it be corrected or updated (Art. 16 GDPR);
  • request the erasure of your personal data (Art. 17 GDPR);
  • request that processing be restricted (Art. 18 GDPR);
  • object to the processing (Art. 21 GDPR);
  • request data portability (Art. 20 GDPR);
  • withdraw previously given consent, without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to the withdrawal (Art. 7.3 GDPR).

To exercise these rights, simply write to info@omniamarketing.it. We will respond within 30 days, as required by Art. 12 of the GDPR.

If you believe that the processing of your data violates applicable law, you have the right to file a complaint with the competent supervisory authority: the Italian Data Protection Authority — Piazza Venezia, 11, 00187 Rome, certified email (PEC) protocollo@pec.gpdp.it, website www.garanteprivacy.it.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.body: This privacy policy may be updated from time to time, for example, in the event of regulatory changes or new services offered by the website. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of the page.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies and Similar Technologies?
sections.body: Cookies are small text files that the websites you visit send to your browser, where they are stored and then sent back to those same websites on your next visit. There are also other technologies with a similar function—such as the browser’s localStorage—which are not technically cookies but which, if used to recognize a user over time, are treated as cookies for the purposes of applicable law (Article 122 of the Italian Privacy Code, which implements the ePrivacy Directive 2002/58/EC, and the Guidelines on Cookies and Other Tracking Tools issued by the Italian Data Protection Authority on June 10, 2021). On this page, when we refer to “cookies,” we mean both categories.

sections.heading: 2. Data Controller
sections.body: Omniaweb S.r.l.s, VAT No. 09553001216, with registered office at Vico Bagnara, 4 — 80135 Naples — info@omniamarketing.it.

sections.heading: 3. What We DO NOT Do
sections.body: Before going into detail, a clear disclaimer: this site does not use profiling cookies for advertising purposes and does not use third-party cookies for marketing purposes. It uses Google Analytics only in aggregate form and only with your consent, as described in section 6. There is no cookie wall: you can browse and use all the main features of the site even if you opt out of all optional tracking.

sections.heading: 4. Necessary technical cookies (no consent required)
sections.body:
These cookies are essential for the website to function or to provide a service that has been explicitly requested, and do not require prior consent (Art. 122, paragraph 1, of the Privacy Code).

NamePurposeDuration
omnia_cookie_consentSaves the choice made in the cookie banner (accepted/rejected) to localStorage so that you are not asked again on every visit.Until manually deleted
Restricted Area SessionAuthentication cookie set only for staff accessing the administrative area (/admin). Does not apply to visitors to the public site.Session duration

sections.heading: 5. Anonymous personalization (requires consent)
sections.body:
If you accept in the initial banner, the site stores the following information on your device using localStorage:

NameContentPurpose
omnia_visitor_profileA randomly generated anonymous identifier, the number of days you return to the site, and the categories of projects/services you visit or click on.To tailor the text, the order of the content displayed, and the call-to-action buttons to what seems to interest you most.
omnia_visitor_nameThe name you choose to provide in the welcome pop-up (optional).Display site text addressing you by name.

The anonymous identifier and the categories you visit (omnia_visitor_profile) remain only on your device; they are never transmitted to our servers. The name you provide in the welcome pop-up, however, is also saved in our database—along with the date, the anonymous identifier alone (never your email address or other identifying information), the approximate city inferred from your connection (we never save your IP address), and a level of interest/engagement calculated based on the pages you visit—so we can track how many people have provided their names and prioritize those who show the most interest when we respond. Under no circumstances is this information cross-referenced with other data or shared with third parties. If you refuse consent, or if you do not provide it, none of this information is created or stored, and the site displays the same default content to all visitors. You can delete both the data on your device and the data stored on the server at any time from the Cookie Preferences section below.

sections.heading: 6. Google Analytics (requires consent)
sections.body:
If you accept in the initial banner, the site uses Google Analytics 4, a statistical analysis service provided by Google Ireland Limited (for users in the European Union), to understand, in aggregate form, how the site is used: how many people visit it, which pages they view, where they come from, and how much time they spend there. We do not use Google’s advertising features (Google Signals, remarketing), and IP addresses are anonymized before being stored.

NamePurposeDuration
_gaDistinguishes users in an aggregated and anonymized form for counting visitors and sessions.Up to 2 years
_ga_*Maintains the status of the current session for Google Analytics 4.Up to 2 years

The data collected by Google Analytics is processed by Google in accordance with its privacy policy and retention policies. If you refuse consent, or if you do not provide it, Google Analytics is never loaded and no data is sent to Google. You can withdraw your consent at any time from the Cookie Preferences section below, or install the Google Analytics opt-out add-on for your browser.

sections.heading: 7. External Resources (Sources)
sections.body: To display the fonts on this website, resources are loaded from Google Fonts and Fontshare. Due to technical reasons related to the operation of the HTTP protocol, loading these resources involves transmitting the device’s IP address to the respective providers; however, no tracking cookies are set for profiling purposes.

sections.heading: 8. Legal Basis
sections.body: Essential technical cookies are processed based on the need to provide the requested service (Art. 122, para. 1, Privacy Code — no consent required). Anonymous personalization and Google Analytics are processed based on the user’s free, specific, and revocable consent (Article 6, paragraph 1, letter a, GDPR), expressed via the initial banner and modifiable at any time as described in point 10.

sections.heading: 9. How to Manage Cookies in Your Browser
sections.body: In addition to the tools provided by this site, you can manage or delete cookies directly from your browser settings. Disabling technical cookies may prevent the site from functioning properly. Official guides: Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge.

sections.heading: 10. Manage and Revoke Consent
sections.body: You can change your selection at any time, just as easily as you made it the first time, using the controls below.

sections.heading: 11. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.body: This Cookie Policy may be updated from time to time, for example, in the event of regulatory changes or new website features. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of the page. In the event of substantial changes that introduce new purposes for data processing, you will be asked to provide your consent again.

sections.heading: 12. Your Rights and Filing a Complaint with the Data Protection Authority
sections.body: For a complete list of the rights recognized by the GDPR and how to exercise them, please see our Privacy Policy. If you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the law, you have the right to file a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority — Piazza Venezia, 11, 00187 Rome, certified email (PEC) protocollo@pec.gpdp.it, website www.garanteprivacy.it.

sections.heading: 13. Contact Information
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please email info@omniamarketing.it.
